voice: A Kubernetes GPU cluster has a lot of moving parts.
One mismatched driver can stall a deployment.
Meet NVIDIA AI Cluster Runtime, or AICR.
It’s open source and makes GPU cluster configurations reproducible.
Describe your target or capture a cluster snapshot.
Choose training or inference, and AICR generates a version-pinned recipe.
Bundle the recipe for the deployer you already use, like Helm or Argo CD.
Validate the deployed cluster against the same recipe.
Check health, performance, and conformance, and optionally publish signed evidence.
As your cluster changes, the optional AICR Operator coordinates rollouts.
Explore the recipes and get involved.
